**Background Research**

- high teacher turnover linked to lower student achievement and weakens structural support for student graduation

  - impacts are worse in areas with higher poverty rates

  - but turnover can be beneficial if they are being replaced with more qualified educators

- chronic turnover can have worse implications by grade level. in high school, this could look like inconsistent academic advising and fewer staff to teacher required courses or electives.

- primary drivers of teacher turnover:

  - Lower pay, lack of administrative support, heavy testing/accountability pressures, and early-career or alternative-route gaps contribute to higher departure rates.

- Defining adjusted graduation rate in MA:

  - "tracks students who stayed in the *same* school or district for all four years (grades 9–12), helping measure how well a school serves its continuous, non-mobile student population."

  - excludes late transfers

- Use state totals unduplicated for teacher retention to see if MA is losing teachers generally from public education workforce.

To what extent do school resources and student characteristics explain differences in Massachusetts high school graduation rates?

- 4 year adjusted grad rate - per school - per year

- stu_grp - race and gender

- school type - org_type (public/charter)

- subject_code - math/ela

  - M_PLUS_E_PCT

- stu_grp - low income, homeless, foster care

- staff_desc - teachers

- retnd_pct

**Step 1: EDA**

```{r}
#| label: load-packages-and-data
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(readr)
library(vroom)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(rstatix)
library(skimr)
library(fixest)
library(marginaleffects)

code_cols <- cols(DIST_CODE = col_character(),
                  ORG_CODE  = col_character(),
                  SY        = col_integer())

hs_grad_rates       <- read_csv("data/hs_grad_rates.csv",
                                col_types = code_cols)  # 2006-2025
student_achievement <- read_csv("data/student_achievement.csv",
                                col_types = code_cols)  # 2017-2026
teacher_retention   <- read_csv("data/teacher_retention.csv",
                                col_types = code_cols)  # 2009-2026

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 10))

snap_year <- 2024 # year for cross section snapshots
```

```{r}
#| label: explore-data

skim(hs_grad_rates)
skim(student_achievement)
skim(teacher_retention)

pct_to_prop <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) x <- parse_number(x)
  if (isTRUE(max(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 1)) x <- x / 100
  x
}

hs_grad_rates<- hs_grad_rates|> 
  mutate(across(ends_with("_PCT"), pct_to_prop))

student_achievement <- student_achievement |> 
  mutate(across(ends_with("_PCT"), pct_to_prop))

teacher_retention   <- teacher_retention|> 
  mutate(across(ends_with("_PCT"), pct_to_prop))
```

```{r}
#| label: build-panels

# Graduation rate type used everywhere below (matches your state plot).
# Switch to "4-Year Adjusted Cohort Graduation Rate" to use the adjusted rate.
grad_type <- "4-Year Graduation Rate"

# Shaded band for the COVID years, reused in the time-series plots
covid <- annotate("rect", xmin = 2019.5, xmax = 2021.5,
                  ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = .12)

# 1a. Teachers and principals at the school level, one row per school-year
ret_school <- teacher_retention |>
  filter(ORG_TYPE == "School", STAFF_DESC %in% c("Teachers", "Principals")) |>
  mutate(staff = if_else(STAFF_DESC == "Teachers", "teach", "princ")) |>
  select(SY, DIST_CODE, DIST_NAME, ORG_CODE, ORG_NAME, staff,
         TOT_CNT, RETND_CNT, RETND_PCT) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = staff, values_from = c(TOT_CNT, RETND_CNT, RETND_PCT)) |>
  rename(teach_n = TOT_CNT_teach, teach_ret_n = RETND_CNT_teach, teach_ret = RETND_PCT_teach,
         princ_n = TOT_CNT_princ, princ_ret_n = RETND_CNT_princ, princ_ret = RETND_PCT_princ) |>
  mutate(princ_left = if_else(princ_n > 0, as.integer(princ_ret_n < princ_n), NA_integer_),
         sector     = if_else(str_detect(DIST_NAME, regex("charter", ignore_case = TRUE)),
                              "Charter", "District"))

# Lags, lead, and 4-year average of teacher retention.
# Retention in SY t = in the job in t-1 and still there in t.
# complete() fills in missing years so lag() really means "previous year".
ret_school <- ret_school |>
  group_by(ORG_CODE) |>
  complete(SY = full_seq(SY, 1)) |>
  arrange(SY, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(teach_ret_lag1  = lag(teach_ret),
         teach_ret_lead1 = lead(teach_ret),
         teach_ret_4yr   = (teach_ret + lag(teach_ret) + lag(teach_ret, 2) + lag(teach_ret, 3)) / 4) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(DIST_CODE))   # drop the filler rows complete() added

# 1b. MCAS: all students, ELA + Math, grades 3-8 combined and grade 10
mcas_sy <- student_achievement |>
  filter(ORG_TYPE %in% c("Public School", "Charter School"),
         STU_GRP == "All Students",
         SUBJECT_CODE %in% c("ELA", "MATH"),
         TEST_GRADE %in% c("ALL (03-08)", "10")) |>
  mutate(band = if_else(TEST_GRADE == "10", "Grade 10", "Grades 3-8")) |>
  group_by(SY, ORG_CODE, band) |>                     # average ELA and Math
  summarise(me_pct = mean(M_PLUS_E_PCT, na.rm = TRUE),
            sgp    = mean(AVG_SGP,      na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(c(me_pct, sgp), ~ if_else(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, .x)))

# 1c. Share of economically disadvantaged students, from MCAS student counts.
# Check the group labels printed in extended-data-explore; DESE renamed this
# group around 2022. Groups under 10 students are suppressed (NA).
econ_grps <- c("Economically Disadvantaged", "Low Income")

demo <- student_achievement |>
  filter(ORG_TYPE %in% c("Public School", "Charter School"),
         SUBJECT_CODE == "ELA", TEST_GRADE %in% c("ALL (03-08)", "10"),
         STU_GRP %in% c("All Students", econ_grps)) |>
  group_by(SY, ORG_CODE, STU_GRP) |>
  summarise(n = sum(STU_CNT), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(SY, ORG_CODE) |>
  summarise(all_n  = sum(n[STU_GRP == "All Students"]),
            econ_n = if (any(STU_GRP %in% econ_grps)) max(n[STU_GRP %in% econ_grps]) else NA_real_,
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(econ_share = if_else(all_n > 0, econ_n / all_n, NA_real_))

# 1d. Pre-COVID (2017-2019) achievement and poverty terciles for each school
baseline <- mcas_sy |>
  filter(SY %in% 2017:2019) |>
  group_by(ORG_CODE) |>
  summarise(base_me = mean(me_pct, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  left_join(demo |> filter(SY %in% 2017:2019) |>
              group_by(ORG_CODE) |>
              summarise(base_econ = mean(econ_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
            by = "ORG_CODE") |>
  mutate(across(c(base_me, base_econ), ~ if_else(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, .x)),
         ach_tercile  = factor(ntile(base_me, 3),
                               labels = c("Low achieving", "Middle", "High achieving")),
         econ_tercile = factor(ntile(base_econ, 3),
                               labels = c("Low poverty", "Middle", "High poverty")))

# 1e. Graduation at the school level, all students
grad_school <- hs_grad_rates |>
  filter(ORG_TYPE == "School", STU_GRP == "All Students",
         GRAD_RATE_TYPE == grad_type) |>
  transmute(SY, ORG_CODE, cohort_n = COHORT_CNT, grad = GRAD_PCT,
            still_in = IN_SCH_PCT, non_grad = NON_GRAD_PCT, ged = GED_PCT,
            dropout = DRPOUT_PCT, excluded = EXCLUD_PCT)

# 1f. Master school-year panel
panel <- ret_school |>
  left_join(baseline, by = "ORG_CODE") |>
  left_join(demo |> select(SY, ORG_CODE, econ_share), by = c("SY", "ORG_CODE"))
```

```{r}
#| label: coverage-and-summary-stats

# How many schools appear in each dataset each year, and how many link up?
coverage <- full_join(
  ret_school |> filter(!is.na(teach_ret)) |> distinct(SY, ORG_CODE) |> mutate(ret = 1),
  mcas_sy |> distinct(SY, ORG_CODE) |> mutate(mcas = 1), by = c("SY", "ORG_CODE")) |>
  full_join(grad_school |> distinct(SY, ORG_CODE) |> mutate(grad = 1), by = c("SY", "ORG_CODE")) |>
  group_by(SY) |>
  summarise(retention    = sum(ret,  na.rm = TRUE),
            mcas         = sum(mcas, na.rm = TRUE),
            grad         = sum(grad, na.rm = TRUE),
            ret_and_mcas = sum(ret & mcas, na.rm = TRUE),
            ret_and_grad = sum(ret & grad, na.rm = TRUE))

kable(coverage, caption = "Schools per year in each dataset")

# Summary statistics for school-years from 2017 on, by sector
panel |>
  filter(SY >= 2017) |>
  left_join(mcas_sy |> filter(band == "Grades 3-8") |> select(SY, ORG_CODE, me_pct, sgp),
            by = c("SY", "ORG_CODE")) |>
  left_join(grad_school |> select(SY, ORG_CODE, grad), by = c("SY", "ORG_CODE")) |>
  select(sector, `Teachers (n)` = teach_n, `Teacher retention` = teach_ret,
         `Principal left` = princ_left, `Econ. disadv. share` = econ_share,
         `% Meet/Exceed (3-8)` = me_pct, `SGP (3-8)` = sgp, `Grad rate` = grad) |>
  pivot_longer(-sector) |>
  filter(!is.na(value)) |>
  group_by(Variable = name, sector) |>
  summarise(N = n(), Mean = mean(value), SD = sd(value),
            P10 = quantile(value, .1), Median = median(value), P90 = quantile(value, .9),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "School-year summary statistics, 2017 onward")
```

```{r}
#| label: retention-by-staff-and-level

# District level counts moves between schools in the district as retained;
# school level does not. Expect the district line to sit above the school line.
teacher_retention |>
  filter(ORG_TYPE %in% c("School", "District")) |>
  group_by(SY, ORG_TYPE, STAFF_DESC) |>
  summarise(mean_ret = mean(RETND_PCT, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = SY, y = mean_ret, color = ORG_TYPE)) +
  covid + geom_point() + geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~STAFF_DESC) +
  labs(title = "Average retention by staff type and level",
       x = "school year", y = "mean percent retained", color = "Level")

# Small schools produce extreme rates by chance (funnel shape)
panel |>
  filter(SY == snap_year, !is.na(teach_ret)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = teach_n, y = teach_ret)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .3) + scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = paste("School teacher retention vs. number of teachers,", snap_year),
       x = "teachers (log scale)", y = "percent retained")
```

```{r}
#| label: turnover-type-decomposition

# school - district = moved within district; district - state = moved between
# districts; 1 - state = left the role in MA public schools.
# Uses counts at each level so the three rates share the same definition of
# "teachers"; check that District >= School every year.
teacher_retention |>
  filter(STAFF_DESC == "Teachers",
         ORG_TYPE %in% c("School", "District") | DIST_NAME == "State Totals Unduplicated") |>
  mutate(level = if_else(ORG_TYPE %in% c("School", "District"), ORG_TYPE, "State")) |>
  group_by(SY, level) |>
  summarise(rate = sum(RETND_CNT, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(TOT_CNT, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = level, values_from = rate) |>
  transmute(SY,
            `Moved within district`         = District - School,
            `Moved between districts`       = State - District,
            `Left role / MA public schools` = 1 - State) |>
  pivot_longer(-SY) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = SY, y = value, fill = name)) + geom_area() +
  labs(title = "Teacher turnover by type", x = "school year", y = "share of teachers", fill = NULL)
```

```{r}
#| label: grad-by-student-group

# Edit to match the labels printed in extended-data-explore
grp_keep <- c("All Students", "Low Income", "Economically Disadvantaged", "High Needs",
              "Students with Disabilities", "English Learners",
              "Black or African American", "Hispanic or Latino", "White", "Asian")

hs_grad_rates |>
  filter(DIST_NAME == "State", STU_GRP %in% grp_keep, GRAD_RATE_TYPE == grad_type) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = SY, y = GRAD_PCT, color = STU_GRP)) +
  covid + geom_point() + geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Graduation rate by student group (state)",
       x = "school year", y = "graduation rate", color = NULL)

# Within-school gap: econ. disadvantaged minus all students,
# by quintile of teacher retention over the cohort's 4 years
grad_gap <- hs_grad_rates |>
  filter(ORG_TYPE == "School", GRAD_RATE_TYPE == grad_type,
         STU_GRP %in% c("All Students", econ_grps)) |>
  mutate(grp = if_else(STU_GRP == "All Students", "all", "econ")) |>
  group_by(SY, ORG_CODE, grp) |>
  summarise(grad = mean(GRAD_PCT), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = grp, values_from = grad) |>
  mutate(gap = econ - all) |>
  inner_join(panel |> select(SY, ORG_CODE, teach_ret_4yr), by = c("SY", "ORG_CODE")) |>
  filter(!is.na(gap), !is.na(teach_ret_4yr)) |>
  mutate(ret_q = factor(ntile(teach_ret_4yr, 5)))

grad_gap |>
  group_by(ret_q) |>
  summarise(mean_gap = mean(gap), se = sd(gap) / sqrt(n()), n = n()) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = ret_q, y = mean_gap)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = mean_gap - 1.96 * se, ymax = mean_gap + 1.96 * se)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(title = "Econ. disadvantaged minus all-student grad rate",
       x = "4-yr teacher retention quintile (1 = lowest)", y = "gap")
```

```{r}
#| label: variance-and-persistence

vd <- panel |>
  filter(!is.na(teach_ret)) |>
  group_by(ORG_CODE) |> mutate(school_mean = mean(teach_ret)) |> ungroup() |>
  group_by(DIST_CODE) |> mutate(dist_mean = mean(teach_ret)) |> ungroup() |>
  group_by(SY) |> mutate(year_mean = mean(teach_ret)) |> ungroup()

tibble(
  component = c("Total variance", "Between districts", "Between schools (persistent)",
                "Within school over time", "Statewide year-to-year"),
  variance  = c(var(vd$teach_ret), var(vd$dist_mean), var(vd$school_mean),
                var(vd$teach_ret - vd$school_mean), var(vd$year_mean))) |>
  mutate(share_of_total = variance / variance[1]) |>
  kable(digits = 4, caption = "Variance of school teacher retention (shares overlap, not additive)")

# This year vs. last year
pers <- panel |> filter(!is.na(teach_ret), !is.na(teach_ret_lag1))
cat("Year-to-year correlation of school teacher retention:",
    round(cor(pers$teach_ret, pers$teach_ret_lag1), 2), "\n")

ggplot(pers, aes(x = teach_ret_lag1, y = teach_ret)) +
  geom_bin2d(bins = 40) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10") +
  labs(title = "Teacher retention: this year vs. last year",
       x = "last year", y = "this year")

# Transition matrix of within-year quintiles
trans <- panel |>
  filter(!is.na(teach_ret)) |>
  group_by(SY) |> mutate(q = ntile(teach_ret, 5)) |> ungroup() |>
  arrange(ORG_CODE, SY) |>
  group_by(ORG_CODE) |>
  mutate(q_prev = if_else(lag(SY) == SY - 1, lag(q), NA_integer_)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(q_prev)) |>
  count(q_prev, q) |>
  group_by(q_prev) |> mutate(p = n / sum(n)) |> ungroup()

ggplot(trans, aes(x = factor(q), y = factor(q_prev), fill = p)) +
  geom_tile() + geom_text(aes(label = round(p, 2)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(title = "Retention quintile transitions (1 = lowest retention)",
       x = "quintile this year", y = "quintile last year", fill = "share")
```

```{r}
#| label: chronic-vs-episodic

# High-turnover year = school is in the bottom 20% of teacher retention that year
chronic <- panel |>
  filter(!is.na(teach_ret)) |>
  group_by(SY) |> mutate(high_turn = teach_ret <= quantile(teach_ret, .2)) |> ungroup() |>
  group_by(ORG_CODE, sector) |>
  summarise(years = n(), share_high = mean(high_turn),
            base_me = first(base_me), base_econ = first(base_econ),
            exits = sum(teach_n - teach_ret_n, na.rm = TRUE),
            teacher_years = sum(teach_n, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(years >= 5) |>
  mutate(type = case_when(share_high == 0 ~ "Stable",
                          share_high < .5 ~ "Episodic",
                          TRUE            ~ "Chronic") |>
           factor(levels = c("Stable", "Episodic", "Chronic")))

school_outcomes <- mcas_sy |>
  filter(band == "Grades 3-8") |>
  group_by(ORG_CODE) |>
  summarise(mean_sgp = mean(sgp, na.rm = TRUE), mean_me = mean(me_pct, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  full_join(grad_school |> group_by(ORG_CODE) |> summarise(mean_grad = mean(grad)),
            by = "ORG_CODE")

chronic |>
  left_join(school_outcomes, by = "ORG_CODE") |>
  group_by(type) |>
  summarise(schools = n(), charter_share = mean(sector == "Charter"),
            econ_share    = mean(base_econ, na.rm = TRUE),
            `M+E % (3-8)` = mean(mean_me,  na.rm = TRUE),
            `SGP (3-8)`   = mean(mean_sgp, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Grad rate`   = mean(mean_grad, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "Schools by turnover pattern")

# Concentration: share of all exits coming from the highest-turnover schools
lorenz <- chronic |>
  mutate(exit_rate = exits / teacher_years) |>
  arrange(desc(exit_rate)) |>
  mutate(cum_teachers = cumsum(teacher_years) / sum(teacher_years),
         cum_exits    = cumsum(exits) / sum(exits))

ggplot(lorenz, aes(x = cum_teachers, y = cum_exits)) +
  geom_line() + geom_abline(linetype = 2) +
  labs(title = "Concentration of teacher exits",
       subtitle = "Schools ordered from highest to lowest exit rate",
       x = "cumulative share of teacher-years", y = "cumulative share of exits")
```

```{r}
#| label: covid-by-school-type
#| fig-height: 8

# Mean school teacher retention by year for each group
plot_by_group <- function(var, title) {
  panel |>
    filter(!is.na({{ var }})) |>
    group_by(SY, grp = {{ var }}) |>
    summarise(mean_ret = mean(teach_ret, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    ggplot(aes(x = SY, y = mean_ret, color = grp)) +
    covid + geom_point() + geom_line() +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "mean teacher retention", color = NULL)
}

plot_by_group(ach_tercile,  "By 2017-19 achievement tercile") /
  plot_by_group(econ_tercile, "By 2017-19 poverty tercile") /
  plot_by_group(sector,       "By sector")

# Gap between high- and low-achieving schools over time
panel |>
  filter(!is.na(ach_tercile)) |>
  group_by(SY, ach_tercile) |>
  summarise(mean_ret = mean(teach_ret, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = ach_tercile, values_from = mean_ret) |>
  mutate(gap = `High achieving` - `Low achieving`) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = SY, y = gap)) +
  covid + geom_point() + geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Retention gap: high- minus low-achieving schools",
       x = "school year", y = "gap")
```

```{r}
#| label: levels-vs-growth

# Remove school and year means by alternating demeaning (= two-way fixed
# effects once it converges)
demean2 <- function(v, g1, g2, iter = 20) {
  for (i in seq_len(iter)) {
    v <- v - ave(v, g1)
    v <- v - ave(v, g2)
  }
  v
}

# Bin x into n equal-sized groups; average x and y in each bin
binscatter_data <- function(df, x, y, n = 20) {
  df |>
    mutate(bin = ntile({{ x }}, n)) |>
    group_by(bin) |>
    summarise(x = mean({{ x }}), y = mean({{ y }}), .groups = "drop")
}

ach <- panel |>
  filter(!is.na(teach_ret)) |>
  inner_join(mcas_sy, by = c("SY", "ORG_CODE")) |>
  filter(!is.na(me_pct), !is.na(sgp))

bins <- map_dfr(c("Grades 3-8", "Grade 10"), function(b) {
  d <- ach |> filter(band == b)
  versions <- list(
    "1. Raw" =
      d |> mutate(xr = teach_ret, me = me_pct, gr = sgp),
    "2. Year-demeaned" =
      d |> mutate(xr = teach_ret - ave(teach_ret, SY),
                  me = me_pct - ave(me_pct, SY),
                  gr = sgp - ave(sgp, SY)),
    "3. School + year demeaned" =
      d |> mutate(xr = demean2(teach_ret, ORG_CODE, SY),
                  me = demean2(me_pct, ORG_CODE, SY),
                  gr = demean2(sgp, ORG_CODE, SY)))
  imap_dfr(versions, function(dd, v)
    bind_rows(binscatter_data(dd, xr, me) |> mutate(outcome = "M+E % (level)"),
              binscatter_data(dd, xr, gr) |> mutate(outcome = "SGP (growth)")) |>
      mutate(version = v, band = b))
})

ggplot(bins, aes(x = x, y = y, color = band)) +
  geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(outcome ~ version, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Teacher retention vs. achievement level and growth",
       x = "teacher retention", y = NULL, color = NULL)

ach |>
  group_by(band) |>
  summarise(`Level, raw`             = cor(teach_ret, me_pct),
            `Growth, raw`            = cor(teach_ret, sgp),
            `Level, school+year FE`  = cor(demean2(teach_ret, ORG_CODE, SY), demean2(me_pct, ORG_CODE, SY)),
            `Growth, school+year FE` = cor(demean2(teach_ret, ORG_CODE, SY), demean2(sgp, ORG_CODE, SY))) |>
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "Correlation of teacher retention with achievement")
```

```{r}
#| label: principal-turnover

# Next year's teacher retention by whether the principal left this year
panel |>
  filter(!is.na(princ_left), !is.na(teach_ret_lead1)) |>
  group_by(econ_tercile, princ_left) |>
  summarise(next_yr_ret = mean(teach_ret_lead1), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Next-year teacher retention by principal departure")

# Each school's first principal departure that follows 2 years with no departure
events <- panel |>
  arrange(ORG_CODE, SY) |>
  group_by(ORG_CODE) |>
  mutate(clean = princ_left == 1 & lag(princ_left) == 0 & lag(princ_left, 2) == 0) |>
  filter(clean %in% TRUE) |>
  summarise(event_year = min(SY))

panel |>
  filter(!is.na(teach_ret)) |>
  group_by(SY) |> mutate(ret_dm = teach_ret - mean(teach_ret)) |> ungroup() |>  # remove year effects
  inner_join(events, by = "ORG_CODE") |>
  mutate(event_time = SY - event_year) |>
  filter(between(event_time, -3, 3)) |>
  group_by(event_time) |>
  summarise(m = mean(ret_dm), se = sd(ret_dm) / sqrt(n()), n = n()) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = event_time, y = m)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, color = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = m - 1.96 * se, ymax = m + 1.96 * se)) +
  labs(title = "Teacher retention around a principal departure",
       subtitle = "Relative to the statewide school mean that year; 95% CIs",
       x = "years since principal departure", y = "teacher retention vs. year mean")
```

```{r}
#| label: grad-outcomes-by-turnover

grad_turn <- grad_school |>
  inner_join(panel |> select(SY, ORG_CODE, teach_ret_4yr, sector),
             by = c("SY", "ORG_CODE")) |>
  filter(!is.na(teach_ret_4yr)) |>
  group_by(SY) |> mutate(ret_q = factor(ntile(teach_ret_4yr, 5))) |> ungroup()

# What happens to students who don't graduate?
grad_turn |>
  group_by(ret_q) |>
  summarise(across(c(still_in, non_grad, ged, dropout, excluded), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>
  pivot_longer(-ret_q) |>
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("excluded", "ged", "non_grad", "still_in", "dropout"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = ret_q, y = value, fill = name)) + geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Non-graduation outcomes by 4-yr teacher retention quintile",
       x = "teacher retention quintile (1 = lowest)", y = "share of cohort", fill = NULL)

# Grad rate vs. 4-year teacher retention, raw and year-demeaned
bind_rows(
  binscatter_data(grad_turn, teach_ret_4yr, grad) |> mutate(version = "Raw"),
  grad_turn |>
    mutate(xr = teach_ret_4yr - ave(teach_ret_4yr, SY), gr = grad - ave(grad, SY)) |>
    binscatter_data(xr, gr) |> mutate(version = "Year-demeaned")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~version, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Graduation rate vs. teacher retention over the cohort's 4 years",
       x = "teacher retention (4-yr avg)", y = "graduation rate")
```
